--- a/attempts/002.sql
+++ b/attempts/003.sql
@@ -1,6 +1,5 @@
-select ch.item_id, ch.item_name, ch.rarity
-from item_tree it
-join item_info ch on it.item_id = ch.item_id
-join item_info pa on it.parent_item_id = pa.item_id
-where pa.rarity = 'RARE'
-order by ch.item_id desc
+SELECT i.item_id, i.item_name, i.rarity
+FROM item_info i
+JOIN item_tree t ON t.item_id = i.item_id
+WHERE t.parent_item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_info WHERE rarity = 'RARE')
+ORDER BY i.item_id DESC;
